iut_type: End Product (IDEAL company product with optional resin cover/case accessory)
customer_question: Our product has an optional resin cover/case accessory that customers can purchase separately — does this accessory need to be included in the Bluetooth SIG registration scope?
question_variants: Do Bluetooth-unrelated optional accessories need to be part of the registration?
actual_issue: The customer wanted to know whether an optional, separately-sold resin cover/case accessory — which has no Bluetooth functionality itself — needed to be declared or included within the scope of their product's Bluetooth SIG registration.
plain_english_explanation: Optional accessories that have no Bluetooth-related function (such as a resin cover/case) do not need to be included in the registration scope, since SIG registration concerns the Bluetooth-implementing product itself, not unrelated bundled or optional accessories.
consultant_answer: No — since the resin cover/case is unrelated to Bluetooth functionality, it does not need to be included in the registration scope.
decision_logic: Registration scope covers only the Bluetooth-implementing device and its relevant hardware/software; accessories without Bluetooth function fall outside this scope regardless of whether they are bundled or sold separately.
final_recommendation: When customers ask whether accessory items need registration, confirm whether the accessory itself implements or affects Bluetooth functionality — if not, it can be excluded from scope.
risk_if_done_wrong: Unnecessarily including unrelated accessories in registration scope could create confusion in the Compliance Folder and registration documentation without any certification benefit.
